zh: 要谈的两件事谈妥了一桩，另一桩得要从嵇鹤龄身上谈起，“雪公！”他开门见山地问：“鹤龄的事怎么了？”一提到这话，王有龄把已送到唇边的酒杯又放下，意兴阑珊地先叹了口气。“为这件事，我睡觉都不安枕。”王有龄说，“我也正要等你商量。抚台不知打的什么主意？迹近过河拆桥，叫我怎么对得起鹤龄兄？”于是他把几次为嵇鹤龄的事，跟黄宗汉去谈的经过，说了一遍，先是请求，没有确实答复，便改做保荐，保荐依旧不得要领，就只好力争，无奈至今争不出名堂来。“雪岩！”王有龄说到最后，又要请教他了，“你料事比别人来得准，倒看看，是何道理？”“ ‘无鬼不死人’！”胡雪岩很坦率地说，“其中必定有鬼。”“我也想到了这一层。”王有龄答道，“问过文案上的人，说要不要有所点缀？文案上的人，回话很诚恳，说这件事全看抚台的意思，他们此刻还不敢受好处，怕受了好处，事情办不成，对不起人。等将来嵇某人的委札下来，自然少不得要讨他一杯喜酒吃。雪岩，你听，这话不是说到头了吗？”
en: One of the two matters had been settled. The other had to begin with Ji Heling. “Mr Xuexuan,” Hu asked directly, “what has happened about Heling?” Wang lowered the glass he had almost raised to his lips and sighed dispiritedly. “It has been keeping me awake at night. I was waiting to discuss it with you. I don’t know what the governor intends. It looks very much as though he means to destroy the bridge after crossing the river. How can I face Brother Heling?” He described his successive approaches to Huang Zonghan. He had first made a request; when no definite answer came, he had submitted a recommendation. That too had achieved nothing, so he had argued the case forcefully. Still there had been no result. “Xueyan, you judge these things more accurately than anyone. What do you make of it?” “There is no death without a ghost at work,” Hu said bluntly. “There must be something underhand behind this.” “I thought so too. I asked the men handling the correspondence whether some little inducement was needed. They answered quite sincerely that everything depended on the governor. They did not dare accept anything yet, for fear of taking a favor and then failing to accomplish the business. Once Mr Ji’s appointment order was issued, of course, they would expect him to treat them to a celebratory drink. Xueyan, surely that says all there is to say?”

zh: 王、嵇两个人两样的活，摆到胡雪岩心里一辨味道，立刻就懂了。两千银子是黄宗汉要，却又不肯叫王有龄出，所以才有这样的话，如果是文案上要钱，管你这银子姓王姓嵇，只要成色足就行了！懂是懂了，却不肯说破。说破了，王有龄即或花了钱，仍旧会觉得替嵇鹤龄不曾尽到心而感疚歉，在嵇鹤龄则既有那样不愿花钱买官做的表示，说破了更会成僵局。于是他笑笑说道：“他们闹鬼，我就是专捉这路鬼的‘茅山道士’。且看我的手段！““那么，你预备如何‘捉鬼’？”王有龄问。“天机不可泄漏。”胡雪岩拿手一指嵇鹤龄，“雪公，鹤龄给我的信上，谈到漕米海运，由浏河出口，因为小刀会起事，怕出乱子，出了个主意你看行不行？”听得这话，嵇鹤龄大为诧异，自己何尝出过什么主意？正要开口，发觉有人轻轻踢了他一脚，这自然是胡雪岩递过来的暗号，嵇鹤龄便不作声了。
en: Comparing Wang’s account with Ji’s, Hu understood at once. The two thousand taels were wanted by Huang Zonghan, who was unwilling to have Wang supply them. That explained these answers. If the money were merely for the correspondence staff, why would they care whether it belonged to Wang or Ji, so long as the silver was good? Hu understood, but would not reveal it. If he did, Wang would still feel guilty that he had failed to do enough for Ji, even if he paid. And Ji, having declared that he would not buy an office, might bring the whole affair to an impasse. Hu therefore smiled. “Let them play their ghostly tricks. I am a Maoshan Taoist who specializes in catching such ghosts. Just watch me!” “And how do you intend to catch them?” Wang asked. “Heaven’s secrets must not be disclosed.” Hu pointed to Ji. “Mr Xuexuan, in his letter Heling mentioned that the tribute rice would go out to sea through Liuhe. Because the Small Swords uprising might cause trouble, he suggested a plan. See what you think of it.” Ji was astonished. When had he suggested any plan? He was about to speak when someone gave him a light kick. Recognizing Hu’s signal, he remained silent.

zh: “什么主意？”王有龄极注意地问，“上头正为这件事在担心，我也很头痛，派兵护漕，原是公事，谁知百端需索，绿营兵真正都该裁撤！”“那好！这个主意用得着了。”胡雪岩不慌不忙他说道，“鹤龄晓得我跟尤五的交情，也晓得尤五的手面，出的主意就是包给尤王驳运。你看如何？”王有龄思索了一下，拍案称赏：“这个主意想绝了！尤五是松江漕帮，说起来便宜不落外方，哪方面都交代得过。鹤龄兄，你真正才气纵横。这样吧，请你今天就做个说帖，我明天上院面递。如果抚台再有罗嗦，那就真正是出了鬼了！”“是，是！”嵇鹤龄答应是在答应，不免有些面红耳热，只是借酒盖脸，一时看不出来。“甚好，甚好！”王有龄举杯说道，“白兰地我也喝过几回，似乎都不如今天的来得香，来得醇。”“ ‘与周公谨交，如饮醇醪’！”嵇鹤龄引了句《三国志》上的话，端杯向王有龄一举，眼却看着胡雪岩。干了这一杯，王有龄说：“酒差不多了。鹤龄兄今晚上还要写说帖，明天晚上到我那里再喝个痛快！”
en: “What plan?” Wang asked attentively. “Our superiors are worrying about it, and it is giving me a headache too. Escorting tribute grain is a public duty, yet the troops make demands at every turn. The whole Green Standard Army ought to be abolished!” “Then this suggestion will be useful,” Hu said calmly. “Heling knows my friendship with You Laowu and the extent of You’s influence. His idea is to contract the transshipment to You. What do you think?” Wang considered, then struck the table in approval. “A splendid idea! You belongs to the Songjiang grain-transport brotherhood, so the benefit would not go to outsiders. It can be justified on every side. Brother Heling, you truly have remarkable talent. Please draw up a memorandum today, and I’ll present it to the governor in person tomorrow. If he still raises objections, there really must be a ghost at work!” “Certainly, certainly,” Ji replied. His face and ears grew hot, though the wine concealed his embarrassment. “Excellent!” Wang raised his glass. “I have drunk brandy several times, but none seemed as fragrant or mellow as this.” “‘Friendship with Zhou Gongjin is like drinking mellow wine,’” Ji quoted from the Records of the Three Kingdoms. He raised his glass toward Wang, but his eyes rested on Hu. After they drank, Wang said, “That is enough wine. Brother Heling still has his memorandum to write tonight. Come to my house tomorrow evening, and we’ll enjoy a proper drink.”

zh: 话刚完，只听瑞云一面掀帘子走了出来，一面笑道：“我还没有敬胡老爷、敬老爷呢？”“敬胡老爷应该，谢媒！”瑞云原有这意思，让王有龄一说破，便不好办了，一手执壶、一手持杯，僵在那里有些手足无措，幸好，这不过眨眨眼的工夫，因为嵇鹤龄很机警地替她解了围。“还是应该先敬雪公！”他接过壶来说，“雪岩跟我弟兄，那是自己人。”“糟了！”王有龄笑道，“你们都是自己人，只剩下一个我是外人。”“老爷也不要这么说，”瑞云窘意消失。依然很会应酬了，“胡老爷跟格老爷都没有拿老爷当外人看。”“对了！”有了几分酒意的王有龄，词锋特别锐利，“女心外向，倒是你拿我当外人看了。”“我不敢！”虽是戏言，瑞云却当作正经话回答，“我在老爷家十几年，不敢忘记者爷、太太待我的好处。”说到这样的话，王有龄就是借酒盖脸，也不好意思跟她再说笑话，规规矩矩受了她一杯酒。接着，瑞云又敬了胡雪岩，放下杯子要走，他喊住了她，要她也敬嵇鹤龄。这时候的瑞云可大方不起来了！但越是不肯，胡雪岩越闹得厉害，把几个小把戏都招引了来，在门帘后面遮遮掩掩地看热闹，特别是最调皮的丹荷，格格地笑个不住。嵇鹤龄借着去叱斥儿女的机会，算是替瑞云又解了围。
en: As he finished, Ruiyun lifted the curtain and came out smiling. “But I haven’t yet offered a toast to Master Hu or to you, sir.” “You certainly ought to toast Master Hu—to thank your matchmaker!” That had indeed been her intention, but Wang’s saying it aloud made things difficult. With the wine pot in one hand and a cup in the other, she stood awkwardly at a loss. It lasted only a moment before Ji came cleverly to her rescue. “Mr Xuexuan should be toasted first,” he said, taking the pot. “Xueyan and I are brothers. He is one of the family.” “How unfortunate!” Wang laughed. “You are all family, and I’m the only outsider.” “You mustn’t say that, sir.” Ruiyun recovered her composure and her skill in social conversation. “Neither Master Hu nor Master Ji regards you as an outsider.” “Exactly!” A little wine had sharpened Wang’s wit. “A woman’s heart turns toward her husband. It is you who regard me as an outsider.” “I would never dare.” Though he was joking, she answered seriously. “I spent more than ten years in your household. I could never forget your kindness and your wife’s.” Even with wine as an excuse, Wang could hardly continue teasing after that. He accepted her toast with proper courtesy. She then toasted Hu and put down the cup to leave, but Hu stopped her and insisted she toast Ji as well. Now she could not remain at ease. The more she demurred, the more Hu teased, until several children gathered behind the curtain to peep at the fun. Danhe, the most mischievous, giggled incessantly. By turning to scold his children, Ji gave Ruiyun another opportunity to escape.

zh: 饭罢回到书房里去喝茶，又谈正经。王有龄问起胡雪岩说：“驳运一节，你跟尤五谈过没有？”“谈是谈过，没有定局。因为不知道你的意思究竟如何？”“其实你就作了主也一样。”王有龄问：“尤五怎么说？”“尤五还不是一句话！费用好商量，不过要浙江给他们江苏督粮道一件公事。”“公事现成！哪怕就是给汪苏许抚台，也不费什么事。倒是费用一层，还要有个大概数目，才好筹划。”“我想，”胡雪岩说，“总比请派绿营兵保护，要便宜得多。”“ 那行！”王有龄很仔细的想了想道说：“只要尤五真的能够保险，这件事就太妙了！”胡雪岩听出他的意思，是有些不放心尤五，但许多话亦不便跟他说，譬如尤五跟周立春的交情之类。不过既然王有龄有这话，而且又扯上嵇鹤龄，算是他的“条陈”，那么一出纸漏，于他们两个人的前程，都有妨碍，不能不重新考虑。“事情是有七分把握，不过‘不怕一万，只怕万一’，我想，”胡雪岩看着嵇鹤龄说，“条陈里写活动些，让黄抚台去作主。”“不行，不行！”王有龄摇着手说，“他不肯担责任的。”
en: After dinner they returned to the study for tea and resumed their business. “Have you discussed the transshipment with You?” Wang asked Hu. “We have discussed it, but nothing is settled. I did not know your wishes.” “You might just as well have decided yourself. What does You say?” “One word is enough with him. The cost can be negotiated; he only needs an official communication from Zhejiang to the Jiangsu grain transport circuit intendant.” “The document is easily arranged. Even a letter to Governor Xu of Jiangsu would be no trouble. But we need an approximate figure for the expense before we can plan.” “I imagine it will be much cheaper than having Green Standard troops provide an escort.” “Then that will do.” Wang considered carefully. “If You can truly guarantee its safety, this is an excellent arrangement.” Hu heard the uncertainty about You. There were many things he could not conveniently explain, such as You’s friendship with Zhou Lichun. Yet Wang’s concern, and the fact that the proposal was now being attributed to Ji, made reconsideration necessary. If something went wrong, it would jeopardize both men’s careers. “I am reasonably confident, but we must guard against the one chance in ten thousand,” Hu said, looking at Ji. “Perhaps the memorial should leave some room for maneuver and let Governor Huang decide.” “No, no!” Wang waved his hand. “He will not take the responsibility.”

zh: 这一下，事情变得就要重新再谈，胡雪岩因为责任太重、总觉得很难有万全之计，方在沉思之际，嵇鹤龄开了口。“此事要盘马弯弓，有一番做作。”嵇鹤龄说：“现在防务吃紧，各地方都要增添兵力，原有的兵勇尚不敷用，何能再抽人护送漕米？”“啊，啊！”王有龄恍然大悟，“我懂了。”“我也懂了。”胡雪岩说，“不过这话，最好不由雪公来说。”“你是说由绿营自己来说？”王有龄摇摇头，“他们不肯说的，这是趟好差使，又舒服，又有出息，何乐不为？”“舒服却未见得，真的遇见小刀会，开起仗来，绿营不是他们的敌手。”“无奈他们不这么想。我也不能这么说。”王有龄下了个决定：“准定由我面见抚台，相机行事。”“那么，”胡雪岩问道，“条陈呢？”“条陈还是今夜把它拟好，我带了去，宁可备而不用，不可要用而未备。”“既如此，我连夜赶起来。”嵇鹤龄慢了一下说，“我想把雪岩留下来，一起商量，斟酌尽善。雪公看如何？”“也好！”王有龄看着胡雪岩说：“我们就明天上午碰头好了。”
en: The whole matter seemed to require fresh discussion. Hu felt the responsibility was too heavy for any plan to be entirely secure. While he was pondering, Ji spoke. “We must first circle the horse and bend the bow—prepare the ground before acting. Defense is pressing everywhere, and every locality needs more troops. The existing forces are already insufficient. How could men be spared to escort the tribute rice?” “Ah!” Wang exclaimed. “I understand.” “So do I,” Hu said. “But it would be better if those words did not come from you, Mr Xuexuan.” “You mean the Green Standard officers should say it themselves?” Wang shook his head. “They won’t. It is a comfortable and profitable assignment. Why would they refuse?” “Not necessarily comfortable. If they really encounter the Small Swords forces and have to fight, they will be no match for them.” “Unfortunately, they do not think so, and I cannot say it. I’ll see the governor myself and act as circumstances require.” “What about the memorandum?” “Have it drafted tonight all the same. I’ll take it with me. Better to have it ready and not need it than need it and not have it.” “Then I’ll finish it tonight,” Ji said. After a pause, he added, “I should like Xueyan to stay so that we can discuss it and make it as sound as possible. What do you think?” “Very well.” Wang looked at Hu. “We shall meet tomorrow morning, then.”

zh: 这样说停当了，王有龄告辞回家。胡雪岩和嵇鹤龄也就毫无耽搁，立即动手，一个条理清楚，一个笔下来得，不费什么事就已把草稿拟好，重新斟酌一遍，作成定稿，随手誊清，由胡雪岩带走。第二天上午王有龄不出门，专诚在家等候胡雪岩。一到便在书房里闭门密谈，自从新城之乱平服，王有龄愈得黄宗汉的信任，因而妒忌他的人也不少，办事不免多掣时的人，为此他有许多苦恼，要向胡雪岩倾吐。“雪岩，”他说，“我现在有件大事，要跟你商量。听说黄抚台有调动的消息，如果他一走，来接他的人不知怎么样。所以我颇有急流勇退之想。”一听这话，胡雪岩大吃一惊，急急说道：“雪公你怎么起了这么个念头？局面刚刚摆开，正搞得顺手，为啥要打退堂鼓。““一则我怕后任一来，如果彼此不甚对劲，我许多经手的事，收拾起来就会有罗嗦，趁黄抚台在这里，办交卸比较容易，二则江忠源由湖北臬司调升安徽巡抚，他跟我有旧，来信问我，愿意不愿意到安徽去？他跟曾国藩两个，现在圣眷甚隆，我想到他那里去也不错。”“不然！”胡雪岩大为摇头，“安徽地方你不熟悉，我也不熟悉。而且说句老实话，你到安徽，我不会去的，因为我去了也帮不了你的忙！”“好！”王有龄点点头，“你说到这话，我不必再多说，今天就写信，回谢江忠源的好意。”
en: With that agreed, Wang took his leave. Hu and Ji began immediately. One arranged the arguments clearly; the other wrote fluently. They soon produced a draft, reconsidered it, settled the final wording and made a fair copy for Hu to take away. The next morning Wang stayed home especially to await Hu. As soon as he arrived, they shut themselves in the study. Since the Xincheng disturbances had been put down, Wang had gained still more of Huang’s confidence. That also meant more jealous rivals and more obstruction. He had many troubles to pour out to Hu. “Xueyan, there is an important matter I want to discuss. I hear that Governor Huang may be transferred. If he leaves, who knows what his successor will be like? I am strongly tempted to withdraw while things are going well.” Hu was greatly alarmed. “Mr Xuexuan, why should you think of that? We have only just built things up, and everything is running smoothly. Why retreat now?” “First, if the new man and I do not get on, winding up the affairs I have handled could become troublesome. It would be easier to hand them over while Governor Huang is here. Second, Jiang Zhongyuan has been promoted from judicial commissioner of Hubei to governor of Anhui. We are old acquaintances, and he has written to ask whether I would join him there. He and Zeng Guofan are both enjoying great imperial favor. Going to him might be a good move.” “I disagree!” Hu shook his head vigorously. “You do not know Anhui, and neither do I. To speak plainly, if you go there, I shall not go with you, because I could do nothing to help you there.” “Very well.” Wang nodded. “Since you put it that way, there is no more to say. I will write today to decline Jiang’s kind invitation.”

zh: 听他这样表示，胡雪岩自然感到安慰了，然而也不免觉得责任愈重，想了想说：“黄抚台调动的消息，确不确？”“有此一说，不可不防。”王有龄又说，“现在浙江各地，都有土匪滋事的情形，星星之火，可以燎原，黄抚台对这方面非常认真。因为新城的案子办得不错，所以这些差使，以后怕都会落在我头上。海运局的事又不能不拖在那里，实在有点心余力绌。”这就见得嵇鹤龄的事，格外重要。说实话，王有龄比嵇鹤龄本人还急，但他在黄宗汉面前，却是有力使不上，因为论功行赏，王有龄走错了一着棋，或者说，这一着棋，他没有去走，在黄宗汉，对新城一案的酬佣，是早就分配好了的，王有龄和嵇鹤龄两人，给一个密保，一个明保，谁密谁明，他没有意见。当初出奏的时候，如果王有龄说一句：“嵇鹤龄出的力多，请抚台赏他一个密保。”黄宗汉也会照办。就因为少了这一句话，把自己搞成了密保，如果这时候，再力荐嵇鹤龄，仿佛投机取巧，他怕黄宗汉心里不高兴，因而始终不敢多说。这一层苦衷，甚至在胡雪岩面前，都难启齿。而时间隔得愈久，那种近似“冒功”的疚歉愈深，渴望着胡雪岩能出个主意，把这件事，早早办成。“照现在看，恐怕还不是三天两天的事。”王有龄说，“先要谈防务，让黄抚台晓得抽不出兵，然后就让他自己来问，可还有别的好办法？那时我才能把鹤龄的条陈拿出来。你想想，这是多绕弯子的事？”
en: Hu was naturally reassured, but felt his responsibility grow heavier. After reflecting, he asked, “Is the report of Governor Huang’s transfer reliable?” “There is such a rumor, and we must be prepared. Besides, disturbances by bandits are occurring throughout Zhejiang. A spark can set the prairie ablaze. The governor takes the matter very seriously. Because the Xincheng affair was handled well, I fear all these assignments will fall to me in future. Meanwhile I cannot get free of the Sea Transport Bureau. I really am beginning to lack the strength for everything.” This made Ji’s appointment all the more important. In truth, Wang was more anxious about it than Ji himself, but he could not exert his full influence with Huang. In allocating the rewards for Xincheng, Wang had made a wrong move—or rather, failed to make a move at all. Huang had decided from the outset that Wang and Ji would receive one confidential recommendation and one open recommendation between them. He had no preference as to which man received which. Had Wang said when the report went forward, “Ji Heling did more of the work; please favor him with the confidential recommendation,” Huang would have agreed. Because Wang had failed to say this, the confidential recommendation had gone to him. To press Ji’s claims again now might look opportunistic, and he feared displeasing Huang. That was why he had never dared say too much. He could hardly confess this difficulty even to Hu. As time passed, his sense of guilt, almost as though he had appropriated another man’s merit, deepened. He longed for Hu to devise a way to settle the appointment quickly. “As things stand,” Wang continued, “it will probably take more than a day or two. I must first discuss defense and make the governor see that no troops can be spared. Then I must wait for him to ask whether there is another way. Only then can I produce Heling’s memorandum. Think how many turns we have to take!”

zh: 胡雪岩同意他的说法，重新把前因后果考虑了一遍，发觉自己错了！错在想为嵇鹤龄“显显本事”，其实，那个条陈对嵇鹤龄能不能接海运局差使的关系不大。关系还在丈案那里。“人到猪头烂，钱到公事办”！怎么连这两句话都想不起？于是他说：“雪公，我请你缓一缓，快则明天，迟则后天，再去见黄抚台。”“怎么呢？”王有龄问，“你又有什么安排？”“还是那句话。”胡雪岩笑道：“天机不可泄漏。”“好吧！我也不问了，听你的招呼好了。”于是彼此又谈了些在上海、在杭州的情形，话太多一时说不尽，加上王太太又出来很应酬一番，谈起瑞云，越发说个没有完。胡雪岩也索性丢开正事，聊了些闲天，在王家吃了午饭，告辞出门，一直来到阜康替嵇鹤龄办事。
en: Hu agreed. Reviewing the causes and consequences once more, he realized that he had been mistaken. He had wanted Ji to display his abilities. But the memorandum had little bearing on whether Ji could take over the Sea Transport Bureau. The decisive point still lay with the correspondence office. A pig’s head cooks when the fire is brought to it; official business proceeds when the money arrives. How had he forgotten such familiar sayings? “Mr Xuexuan, please wait a little. See the governor tomorrow at the earliest, or the day after at the latest.” “Why? What are you arranging now?” “The same answer as before.” Hu smiled. “Heaven’s secrets must not be disclosed.” “Very well. I won’t ask. I’ll wait for your word.” They went on to talk about events in Shanghai and Hangzhou. There was too much to finish at once, especially when Mrs Wang came out to entertain their guest and the subject turned to Ruiyun. Hu put business aside for a while and joined in the conversation. He stayed for lunch, then went straight to Fukang to attend to Ji’s affairs.

zh: 他就用本号的银票，开了两张，一张两千，一张两百，用个封套封好，上写“匪仪”二字，下面具名是“教愚弟嵇鹤龄”。“庆生！拜托你走一趟，托刘二爷代为递到文案上的陈老爷。说我还有几天忙，杂务稍为定一定，请他过来叙一叙。”“好的。”刘庆生又问：“要不要回片？”“不必了。”胡雪岩说，“他给你就带了回来，不给也不必要，反正心到神知。”刘庆生办事极快，不过一个时辰，就已回店，带来抚署文案委员陈老爷的一张名片，上面有四个字：“拜领谢谢！”于是胡雪岩当夜就通知王有龄，说可以去见抚台谈这件事了。王有龄不知道他葫芦里卖的什么药？反正照他的话做决不会错，因而下一天衣冠整肃地到了抚台衙门。手本递了进去，刘二回出来说：“上头交代，上半天客多，准定请王大爷下半天三点钟来。”凡是上宪专约时刻会商，皆是格外看重的表示，意思是要抽出一段时间，可以从容细谈。王有龄听得这话，便打道回府，到了下午再来。
en: Using his own bank’s notes, he made out two: one for two thousand taels and one for two hundred. He sealed them in an envelope, inscribed it “A humble gift,” and signed beneath, “Your humble junior, Ji Heling.” “Qingsheng, I must ask you to make a visit. Have Master Liu Er pass this to Master Chen in the correspondence office. Say that I shall be busy for a few more days, but once these miscellaneous affairs are settled, I should like him to come over for a talk.” “Very well. Should I ask for a card acknowledging receipt?” “No. If he gives you one, bring it back. If not, there is no need to request it. The intention will be understood.” Liu Qingsheng was quick. Within a double-hour he returned with a visiting card from Master Chen, a correspondence officer at the governor’s office. On it were four characters: “Gratefully received, with thanks.” That night Hu notified Wang that he could now see the governor about the matter. Wang had no idea what Hu had done, but was sure that following his advice would not lead him astray. The following day he dressed formally and went to the governor’s office. After his calling document was taken in, Liu Er returned. “His Excellency says he has many visitors this morning. He asks that you come at three this afternoon.” When a superior set aside a specific time for consultation, it was a sign of special regard: he meant to allow an unhurried discussion. Wang therefore went home and returned in the afternoon.

zh: 黄宗汉在巡抚衙门后花园的“船厅”接见，一到叫先换了便衣，接着便邀王有龄一起吃点心，千层糕、燕皮汤、地力糕，甜咸俱备，冷热皆有，都是他们八闽的家乡口味。一面吃，一面谈，先谈时局，说向荣的江南大营，每月耗饷甚巨，公文急如星火，催索不已，是件很伤脑筋的事。“这也不该浙江一省出。”王有龄表示意见，“需索无底，难以为继，大人似乎可以跟向帅商量，是不是通盘筹划，由江苏、江西、浙江三省，每月确定额数，到期报解？这样子，大家筹措起来也比较容易。”“你这个主意不错，我可以试一试。”黄宗汉又说，“你湖州这方面，关系甚重，通省的饷源，主要的就靠你那里。我看，海运局你真有点兼顾不到了！”
en: Huang received him in the Boat Hall in the rear garden of the governor’s residence. He first asked Wang to change into informal clothes, then invited him to share refreshments: layered cake, yanpi soup, water-chestnut cakes, sweet and savory dishes, hot and cold—all flavors of their native Fujian. As they ate, they discussed the situation. Huang began with Xiang Rong’s Jiangnan Grand Camp, which consumed enormous sums every month. Its official demands for money arrived with the urgency of a fire alarm and never ceased. It was a severe headache. “Zhejiang should not have to provide everything,” Wang offered. “The demands are endless and cannot be sustained. Might you discuss an overall arrangement with Commander Xiang? Jiangsu, Jiangxi and Zhejiang could each be assigned a fixed monthly sum, to be remitted when due. That would make it easier for everyone to raise the funds.” “A good suggestion. I can try it,” Huang said. “Your work in Huzhou is particularly important. The province depends chiefly on that district for military funds. I think the Sea Transport Bureau is indeed more than you can also manage.”

zh: 王有龄心里有些嘀咕，听这意思，抚台夹袋中似乎有人，倘或此时就提了出来，一个上司，一个下属，直来直往，中间没有缓冲的余地，嵇鹤龄岂不是就落空了？这还在其次，如果换一个人来，立刻就得办移交，海运局的亏空，除非能找一笔钱来补上，否则就会原形毕露，那怎么得了？一想到此，额上便见了汗。黄宗汉不知就里，随即说道：“十月小阳春，天气太热。你请升冠吧！”升冠就是脱帽，是不礼貌的，王有龄拿块手巾擦擦汗说：“不要紧，不要紧！”这是小事，黄宗汉也不再多说，又谈公事：“那个姓嵇的，我看倒有点才气。”听得这一句，王有龄顿觉心头一宽，耳目清凉，赶紧答道：“大人目光如炬，凡是真才，都逃不过大人的耳目。”这一声恭维，相当得体，黄宗汉瘦刮刮的脸上有了笑容，“让他接你的海运局。”他用征询的语气说：“你看怎么样？”“那是再适当不过。”王有龄乘此机会答道：“嵇鹤龄此人，论才具是一等一，有人说他脾气太傲，也不见得。有才气的人，总不免恃才傲物，不过所傲者，是不如他的人。其实他也是颇懂好歹的，大人能够重用他，我敢写包票，他一定会感恩图报，让大人称心如意。”最后一句话，意在言外，不尽关乎公事妥帖。黄宗汉其实也不需他“写包票”，胡雪岩那张阜康的银票，比王有龄的“包票”更来得有力。所以他点点头说：“我知道！你就回去准备交卸吧！”
en: Wang grew uneasy. From this remark, it sounded as though the governor already had someone in mind. If he named the man now, with superior and subordinate face to face and no room for an intermediary, would Ji not lose his chance? Worse still, another man’s arrival would require an immediate handover. Unless money could be found to cover the deficit at the Sea Transport Bureau, the shortage would be exposed. That would be disastrous. Sweat appeared on Wang’s forehead. Unaware of the cause, Huang said, “This little spring in the tenth month is very warm. Please remove your hat.” To do so in a superior’s presence was discourteous. Wang wiped his brow with a handkerchief. “It’s quite all right.” Huang did not insist over a small matter and returned to business. “That fellow Ji seems to have some ability.” At these words Wang felt his heart lighten and his senses clear. “Your Excellency has a discerning eye. No true talent can escape your notice.” The compliment was well judged, and Huang’s lean face broke into a smile. “Let him take over your work at the Sea Transport Bureau,” he said as though seeking advice. “What do you think?” “Nothing could be more suitable. Ji Heling’s ability is of the first order. Some call him too proud, but I do not entirely agree. Talented men may be proud of their gifts, yet their scorn is directed at those inferior to themselves. He understands very well how he ought to behave. If Your Excellency gives him an important appointment, I guarantee that he will repay the favor and give you complete satisfaction.” The last words implied more than competent public service. Huang did not really need Wang’s guarantee: Hu’s Fukang banknote carried greater force. He nodded. “I know. Go back and prepare to hand over.”

zh: “是！”王有龄站起身来请了一安：“大人容我暂息仔肩，真是体恤我。”“不敢当，快请起来。”黄宗汉也站起来，虚抉一扶。这一站起来，不再坐下，便是等待送客的表示。“我就告辞了。”王有龄敲钉转脸地加了一句：“我回去就将大人这番栽培的德意，告诉秩某人，叫他实心报效。”“可以，你就告诉他好了。我马上叫人下委札。”
en: “Yes, sir!” Wang rose and made a formal obeisance. “Your Excellency’s allowing me some relief from my burden is a great kindness.” “Not at all. Please rise.” Huang stood too and made a gesture of assistance. Remaining on his feet signaled that he was ready to see his visitor out. “I shall take my leave,” Wang said, adding a final sentence to make the matter firm. “I will tell Mr Ji at once of Your Excellency’s gracious encouragement and ask him to serve you wholeheartedly.” “You may tell him. I will have the appointment order issued immediately.”

zh: 于是王有龄告辞回家，第一件事就是派人去请胡雪岩和嵇鹤龄。自然是胡雪岩先到，因为阜康离王家不远，而他是早就关照了王家门上的，有事到阜康招呼，所以一请就到。“佩服，佩服！”王有龄翘看大拇指说，“雪岩，你具何神通，料事如此之准？”接着，他把会见黄宗汉的经过，细说了一遍。胡雪岩也不曾料到事情是这样子的顺利，因而也有喜出望外之感，想了想问道：“那么，条陈是怎么说法？”“条陈不曾上。”王有龄答道，“一拿出来，倒显得早有成算似地。大人物分两种，一种喜欢先意承志，事事先替他想到，一种是喜欢用不测之威，不愿意别人知道他的心思，黄抚台就是这一类人。我觉得等鹤龄接了事，或者谢委的时候，当面请求比较好。”“事情要快，就让他谢委的时候请求吧！”胡雪岩又问，“运枪的公事……”“啊！把这件事给忘记掉了。”王有龄说，“不要紧，我写封信就行了。”刚把信写完，嵇鹤龄到了。王、胡二人一见他先道贺，然后略说缘由，嵇鹤龄有点摸不清首尾，不知道是谁的力量使然？唯有向他们两个人都道了谢。这时王家的男女佣仆也都来磕头道喜，嵇鹤龄正带着一张三十两银子的银票在身上，很大方地发了“总赏”，还有人说要给瑞云道贺，又说她福气好！尤其是待嫁的两名丫头，眼看瑞三“飞上枝头作风凰”，艳羡之意，溢于词色。这就不但是嵇鹤龄，连胡雪岩也觉得很得意。这样喜气洋洋地乱过一阵，王有龄便说：“鹤龄兄，你请回去吧！说不定已有送喜信的人到府上去了。雪岩帮着一起去招呼招呼，我们晚上再谈。”
en: Wang’s first act on returning home was to send for Hu and Ji. Naturally, Hu arrived first. Fukang was nearby, and he had already told Wang’s gate attendants to look for him there whenever needed. “Wonderful, wonderful!” Wang said, raising his thumb. “Xueyan, what miraculous powers do you possess, to judge events so exactly?” He recounted the interview in detail. Hu had not expected such smooth success either and was delighted. After a moment he asked, “What happened about the memorandum?” “I did not present it. Producing it would have made us seem to have planned everything beforehand. There are two kinds of great men. One likes others to anticipate his wishes and think everything through for him. The other likes to exercise an unpredictable authority and does not want anyone to know his mind. Governor Huang is the second kind. I thought it better for Heling to make the request himself after taking office, or when he goes to thank the governor for the appointment.” “It must be done quickly. Let him raise it when he gives thanks. And the papers for transporting the guns?” “Ah, I forgot about those. Never mind—a letter from me will do.” He had just finished writing when Ji arrived. Wang and Hu congratulated him and briefly explained what had happened. Ji could not quite grasp the sequence or tell whose influence had brought it about, so he thanked them both. The male and female servants of the Wang household came to kowtow and offer congratulations. Ji happened to have a thirty-tael note with him and generously gave it as a reward to be shared among them. Some said Ruiyun should be congratulated too and praised her good fortune. The two maids awaiting marriage were particularly envious of her rise from a lowly perch to the station of a phoenix. Their admiration showed in every word and expression. Hu felt almost as pleased as Ji himself. After this happy bustle, Wang said, “Brother Heling, you had better go home. Messengers with congratulations may already be there. Xueyan, go with him and help attend to matters. We will talk again tonight.”

zh: 叫胡雪岩去招呼，是招呼成赏，这方面的“行情”他不大熟悉，少不得先要向王有龄问清楚了，然后顺道往阜康交代了几句话，才一起回到嵇家。“二弟！”嵇鹤龄在轿子里把事情想通了，一到家率直问道：“可是你走了门路？”因为嵇鹤龄说过不愿买官做的话，所以胡雪岩的回答很含蓄：“也不过托人去说过一声。”“怎么说法？”“无非拜托而已。”嵇鹤龄静静地想了想说：“我也不多问了，反正我心里知道就是！”正说到这里，刘庆生也到了嵇家，他是奉了胡雪岩的指示，送东西来的，一千两银票、五百两现银，另外一扣存折，上面还有三千五百两。“二弟！”嵇鹤龄把存折托在手里说，“我觉得沉重得很，真有点不胜负荷。”这是说欠他的情太多了，怕还不清，“自己弟兄，何必说这话？”胡雪岩答值：“而且水帮船，船帮水，以后仰仗大哥的事还多。”“这用不着说，你的事就是我的事。海运局的内幕，我还不大清楚，要你帮我的忙，才能顶得下来。“
en: By helping attend to matters, Wang meant seeing to the customary rewards. Hu did not know the going rates very well, so he first asked Wang for details. Then he stopped at Fukang to leave instructions before accompanying Ji home. “Second Brother,” Ji said directly when they arrived, having thought it through in the sedan chair, “did you work through someone?” Because Ji had declared that he would not buy an office, Hu answered discreetly. “I merely asked someone to put in a word.” “What sort of word?” “Only a request for help.” Ji reflected in silence. “I won’t ask further. I understand in my heart.” Just then Liu Qingsheng arrived, carrying what Hu had instructed him to bring: a thousand-tael banknote, five hundred taels in silver, and a passbook showing another three thousand five hundred. Holding the passbook, Ji said, “Second Brother, this weighs heavily on me. I can scarcely bear it.” He meant that he owed more kindness than he feared he could repay. “We are brothers. Why say such things?” Hu replied. “Water helps the boat, and the boat helps the water. There will be plenty of occasions when I must depend on you.” “That goes without saying. Your business is mine. I do not yet know the inner workings of the Sea Transport Bureau. I shall need your help to manage it.”

zh: 刚谈到这里，只见听差引进一位客来，是抚台衙门的一名戈什哈，这是满洲话“侍奉”的意思，转用为护卫的名称，到了后来，凡是督抚左右跑腿的差官，叫做“戈什哈”，此人戴着个金顶子，也是个八品官儿，但遇见候补州县七品官的嵇鹤龄，不敢以官自居，抢上来请两个安，一面口称，“恭喜嵇大老爷！”这自是报喜信的，嵇鹤龄连称：“不敢当！”扶起来请教：“贵姓？”“不敢！敝姓朱。抚台派我在文案上当差，文案陈老爷特别派来跟嵇大老爷报喜。”说着，从“护书”中，取出来一封盖着紫泥大印的委札，双手捧向嵇鹤龄。委扎不曾封口，取出来一看，不错，是接王有龄“海运局坐办”。嵇鹤龄顺手交了给胡雪岩，转脸向姓朱的说一声：“劳你的驾，请坐了说话！”“不敢！”姓朱的说：“陈老爷交代，说先跟嵇大老爷道喜，晚上再来拜会，又交代：抚台今天身子不大爽快，嵇老爷今天不必谢宴，等到明天上院好了。”“好，好！费心你转达陈老爷，多承他关照，心感万分。准定我今天晚上到他府上去拜访。”“是，”姓朱的又说：“请嵇大老爷赏个名片，我好回去交差。”
en: Their conversation was interrupted by a servant showing in a visitor, a goshha from the governor’s office. The Manchu word originally meant attendance or service, then came to denote a guard; later it was used for the officers who ran errands for governors and governors-general. This man wore a gold hat finial and held the eighth rank. But before Ji, an expectant magistrate of the seventh rank, he dared not stand on his own official status. He hurried forward and made two formal salutations. “Congratulations, Master Ji!” He had plainly come with the good news. Ji modestly disclaimed the honor, helped him up and asked his surname. “My unworthy surname is Zhu. The governor assigned me to the correspondence office. Master Chen sent me especially to congratulate you.” From his document case he produced an appointment order bearing a large purple seal and offered it with both hands. The envelope was unsealed. Ji took out the order and read it: he was indeed to succeed Wang as executive director of the Sea Transport Bureau. He passed it to Hu and turned back to Zhu. “Thank you for your trouble. Please sit down.” “I would not presume. Master Chen asked me to congratulate you first and to say that he will call this evening. He also said the governor is not feeling quite well today. You need not go to thank him for the appointment until tomorrow.” “Very well. Please tell Master Chen how deeply grateful I am for his attention. I shall certainly visit his residence this evening.” “Yes, sir. May I have your visiting card to report completion of my errand?”

zh: 这是早准备好的，一张名帖，一封二十两银子的红包。刚打发了姓朱的，只见瑞云走了出来，穿一件紫缎夹袄，系一条雪青绸裙，一朵红花，盈盈笑道：“嵇老爷我来道喜！”“怎样！”嵇鹤龄有些意外，也有些手足无措似地，“你也来这一套，何必！免了，免了。”“应该的。嵇老爷大喜！”说着，她手抉左腰裣在为礼，随后又喊：“荷官，带了弟弟、妹妹来替爹爹磕头。”于是丹荷领头，一群小把戏，推推拉拉地都从门边出现，显然是瑞云早就安排好的，一个个都象过年的样子，穿得整整齐齐的衣服，在一长条毡条上，七跌八撞地，一面磕头，一面笑着。嵇鹤龄扶住这个，抱住那个，嘴里还要应付调皮的丹荷“讨赏”，乱到十分，也热闹到了十分。“瑞云！”嵇鹤龄等乱过一阵，这样说道：“实在要谢谢二老爷……”“是啊！”瑞云抢着按口，“不过倒不是谢谢二老爷，也是要跟二者爷道喜。”“同喜，同喜！双喜临门，喜酒吃不完。”胡雪岩笑道，“瑞云，都是你带来的运气。”这句话说得瑞云心花怒放。不自觉地就瞟了嵇鹤龄一眼，然后正一正脸色说道：“这有好几天可以忙了。马上就有道喜的人来，茶烟点心，都要早早预备，二老爷请宽坐，我不陪你了。”说着又福了福，转身而去。
en: This had already been prepared: a visiting card and a red envelope containing twenty taels. As soon as Zhu had been sent off, Ruiyun appeared in a lined purple satin jacket and a pale violet silk skirt, with a red flower in her hair. Smiling, she said, “Master Ji, I have come to congratulate you.” “What is this?” Ji was surprised and a little flustered. “Must you observe these formalities too? There is no need. Please don’t.” “It is only proper. My warmest congratulations, Master Ji.” Resting a hand at her left waist, she made a formal curtsy, then called, “Danhe, bring your brothers and sisters to kowtow to your father.” Danhe led the children out from behind the door, pushing and jostling. Ruiyun had clearly arranged it all beforehand. Dressed as neatly as for New Year, they stumbled onto a long felt mat, laughing as they bowed. Ji helped one up and gathered another into his arms, while trying to answer mischievous Danhe’s demands for a reward. The confusion and merriment could hardly have been greater. When it subsided, Ji said, “Ruiyun, we really must thank Second Master.” “Yes,” she interjected, “but it isn’t merely thanks we owe him. We should congratulate him too.” “Congratulations all round! Two joys at one door, and no end of celebratory wine!” Hu laughed. “Ruiyun, you brought all this good fortune.” The compliment filled her with delight. She could not help glancing at Ji, then composed her expression. “We shall be busy for several days. Well-wishers will arrive soon, so tea, tobacco and refreshments must be prepared. Please make yourself comfortable, Second Master. I must leave you.” She curtsied again and withdrew.

zh: 大家妇女的派头，讲究稳重，行路无声，裙幅不动，才是福相，瑞云居然亦有这副风范，使得胡雪岩大感意外，大概婢学夫人，早就有心了，于此见得她的志气，不由得赞了一声：“实在不错！”嵇鹤龄也看到了瑞云那俨然命妇的派头，自然也很得意，得意思往，想到两个月前与胡雪合初见的光景，恍似梦寐，这是一个令人沉醉的春梦，而且一时不会醒，还有更妙的梦境在后面。无量欢喜竟化作浓重感慨，“提起来也真好笑！”他说，“记得我们第一天见面，我还埋怨你跟雪公做下圈套，令人拒之不可，受之不甘。谁知是这样的圈套，只怕再耿介的人，也要去钻一钻。“提到这个回忆，胡雪岩更觉得意，从与王有龄认识以来，他出过许多奇奇怪怪的花样，而以“收服嵇鹤龄”最足以自豪，因为第一，救了新城地方一场刀兵之灾，其次，帮了王有龄一个大忙，复次，好人出出头，使得嵇鹤龄不致有怀才不遇之叹，第四，促成了一头良缘，最后，自己交了一个亲如骨肉的好朋友。一举而众善备，自觉这个脑筋动得实在不坏。于是他半开玩笑他说道：“我听你谈过，说汉高祖的陈平，出过多少条奇计，我的奇计也很多，大小由之，大才大用，小才小用，只看对方自己怎么样。”
en: The bearing of a woman from a great household required composure: a noiseless step and a skirt whose folds did not stir were considered signs of good fortune. To Hu’s surprise, Ruiyun already possessed this manner. She had probably long meant to emulate the mistress she had served. Her ambition was evident, and he could not help exclaiming, “Very good indeed!” Ji too had noticed how completely she looked the part of an official’s lady, and was naturally pleased. His thoughts wandered back to his first meeting with Hu two months before. It seemed like a dream—an intoxicating spring dream from which he would not soon wake, with still more delightful scenes ahead. His boundless happiness turned into deep reflection. “It is really rather amusing,” he said. “On the day we first met, I complained that you and Mr Xuexuan had laid a trap: one I could neither refuse nor willingly accept. Who would have thought it was a trap like this? Even the most uncompromising man might want to walk into it.” The memory made Hu still prouder. Since meeting Wang, he had devised many unusual schemes, but none pleased him more than winning over Ji Heling. First, it had saved Xincheng from the disaster of armed conflict. Second, it had greatly helped Wang. Third, it had allowed a worthy man to advance instead of lamenting that his talent went unrecognized. Fourth, it had brought about a happy match. Finally, Hu himself had gained a friend as close as flesh and blood. One action had achieved so many good things. He felt that his ingenuity had served him well. Half joking, he said, “You once told me how many extraordinary schemes Chen Ping devised for Emperor Gaozu of Han. I have plenty of schemes too, for great matters and small. Great talents can be put to great use and lesser talents to lesser use. It all depends on the person concerned.”

zh: “是的！嵇鹤龄说：”你应该是诸侯的上客，象现在这样是委屈了。““那也不见得。事在人为！”胡雪岩跟嵇鹤龄交谈，话中不知不觉就有书卷气了，“俗语说得好，‘将相本无种，男儿当自强’，我现在虽不是诸侯的上客，帮人做到诸侯的位分，自然就是上客了。”“这话说得好！乱世本来是出人才的时候，征诸史书，历历可见。”“书上怎么说，我不晓得。不过，大哥，”胡雪岩的脸上，显出那种在他难得有的、古板正经的神色，“你说现在是出人才的时世，我相信！乱世故事，不必讲资格例规，人才容易出头。再有一层，你到过上海，跟洋人打交道，就晓得了，洋人实在有洋人的长处，不管你说他狡猾也好，寡情薄义也好，有一点我们及人家不来，人家丁是丁、卯是卯，你说得对，他一定服你，自己会认错。不象我们，明明晓得这件事锗了，不肯承认，仿佛认了错，就失掉了天朝大国的面子。象洋人那样，不会埋没你的好处，做事就有劲了，才气也容易发挥了。凡是有才气的人，都是喜欢做事的，不一定为自己打算。所以光是高官厚禄，不见得能出人才，只出旗人对皇上自称的‘奴才’！““嘿！”嵇鹤龄睁大了眼说：“想不到你能这么痛快的议论。书，我比你多读了几句，论世故，我实在不及你。”“我是瞎说的。”胡雪岩谦虚着，“吃亏还在书读得少。”
en: “Indeed,” Ji replied. “You ought to be the honored adviser of a great lord. Your present position does not do you justice.” “Not necessarily. Things depend on human effort.” Talking with Ji had unconsciously given Hu’s speech a literary flavor. “As the saying goes, generals and ministers are not born of a special breed; a man must strive for himself. I may not be a great lord’s honored adviser now, but if I help someone rise to that position, I shall naturally become one.” “Well said! Troubled times bring talent forward. History gives us example after example.” “I don’t know what the books say. But, Elder Brother,” Hu’s face took on a rare expression of sober seriousness, “I believe you when you say this is an age in which talent can rise. In troubled times, one need not be bound by seniority and established rules, so capable men have a better chance. There is something else. If you go to Shanghai and deal with foreigners, you will see that they have real strengths. Call them cunning if you like, or cold and lacking in loyalty. In one respect we cannot match them: they distinguish clearly between right and wrong. If you are right, they acknowledge it and admit their own mistake. We may know perfectly well that we are wrong and still refuse to admit it, as though doing so would cost our great celestial empire its dignity. When people recognize your merits as foreigners do, you have more energy for work and more chance to use your abilities. Talented people like to accomplish things; they are not necessarily thinking only of themselves. High office and generous pay alone may therefore produce no talent at all—only the ‘slaves’ that Bannermen call themselves before the emperor.” “Well!” Ji opened his eyes wide. “I never expected such a spirited argument from you. I may have read a few more books, but in knowledge of the world I cannot compare with you.” “I am only talking at random,” Hu said modestly. “My lack of reading remains a disadvantage.”

zh: “不然，不然！”嵇鹤龄不断摇头，换了个后题，“我说过，我想认识几个江湖上的朋友，第一个是尤五，这一回少不得要借重他了，我想接了事，先到上海、松江走一趟，一则看看海口的情形，再则专诚去拜访尤五，不晓得你能不能陪我一起走？”“可以，我本来在上海也还有好些事要料理。不过，此刻来说，言之过早。等你明天谢了委、接了事再来商量，也还不迟。”说到这里，张贵来报，有道喜的客来了。这位贺客是裘丰言，向主人道过喜，便来跟胡雪岩招呼，将他奉若神明，因为裘丰言原来最佩服嵇鹤龄，而胡雪岩能使得恃才傲物的嵇鹤龄服帖，进而结为昆季，这就象如来佛收服孙悟空一般，不能不令人倾倒。胡雪岩也很喜欢裘丰言，此人生来心肠热、脾气好、肯吃亏，最难得的是眼力高，识得人的长处，而且衷心敬服。同时他的趣味别具一格，说他俗，俗到不堪言状，说他雅，做两件别出心裁的事，比雅人还雅，这就是嵇鹤龄能够跟他成为好朋友的一大原因。至于胡雪岩的喜欢他，是喜欢他那副生气勃勃的劲道，哪怕家里等米下锅，外面看来是吃饱睡足只想找乐趣的样子。
en: “Not at all, not at all.” Ji shook his head and changed the subject. “I told you that I wanted to meet some friends from the brotherhood world, You Laowu first among them. We shall certainly need his help now. After taking up my duties, I should like to visit Shanghai and Songjiang, both to inspect conditions at the sea outlet and to call on You in person. Could you come with me?” “Yes. I have many things to attend to in Shanghai myself. But it is too early to settle that. Let us discuss it after you have thanked the governor and taken office tomorrow.” At this point Zhang Gui announced a visitor bearing congratulations. It was Qiu Fengyan. After greeting the host, he turned to Hu with almost reverential admiration. Qiu had always admired Ji above others. That Hu could win over such a proud man of talent and go on to become his sworn brother seemed like the Buddha’s subduing the Monkey King. It could not fail to inspire awe. Hu was fond of Qiu too. The man was warmhearted, good-tempered and willing to take a loss. Most unusually, he could recognize the strengths of others and admire them sincerely. His tastes were distinctive. In some respects he was vulgar beyond description; yet he could do something so original and refined that it outdid the cultivated. That was one reason Ji was able to be his close friend. What Hu particularly liked was his lively spirit. Even if his family had no rice for the cooking pot, he looked as though he had eaten well, slept soundly and wanted only to enjoy himself.

zh: 胡雪岩因材器使，马上替他想到了一桩“差使”：“老裘，你今天就不要走了！替主人陪陪客。”“义不容辞！”裘丰言笑嘻嘻地答道：“鹤龄兄春风得意，声名鹊起，贺客必多，都归我招呼。摆酒唱戏‘开贺’，我心里也有谱了，起码有十天好热闹。”“嗳，老兄，老兄！”嵇鹤龄连忙拦着他说：“你少给我出点花样，弄出暴发户的样子来！”“做此官，行此礼，哪个不是这样子热闹热闹的？”“斯世何世？长毛找到黄河以北，上海又是小刀会起事，我们在这里瞎起哄，给京里‘都老爷’晓得了，随便什么奏陈时政的析子上，带上一笔，吃不了还兜着走呢！”“这倒也是实话。”胡雪岩一想是该当心，“老裘，眼前不必铺张，自己人悄悄玩一两天，有个庆贺的意思，也就够了。好在至迟年底，总还有一场热闹。”“对，对！”裘丰言“从善如流”地连声答应，“鹤龄兄，年底纳宠之喜，也就跟洞房花烛的‘小登科’一样。到那时候，你总不能委屈我们那位才貌双全、既贤且惠的如嫂夫人了吧？”“这也再说。如果公事顺手，年下无事，倒不妨热闹热闹。”“好，有这句话就行了。年下办喜事，自然也是我的‘总管？’。”
en: Hu at once thought of a task suited to him. “Old Qiu, don’t go away today. Help our host entertain his visitors.” “A duty I cannot refuse!” Qiu replied cheerfully. “Brother Heling is riding the spring breeze, and his reputation is soaring. There will be plenty of callers; leave them all to me. I have plans for the celebration too—banquets and opera. We can have at least ten days of festivities.” “Wait, my dear fellow!” Ji hastily stopped him. “Spare me your schemes. You’ll make me look like a man who has suddenly come into money.” “Every office has its appropriate ceremony. Who doesn’t celebrate a little?” “What times are we living in? The Long-Haired rebels have fought their way north of the Yellow River, and the Small Swords have risen in Shanghai. If we make a senseless uproar here and one of the censors in Beijing hears of it, a passing mention in a memorial on public affairs could bring us more trouble than we could carry.” “That is true,” Hu agreed, recognizing the need for caution. “Old Qiu, there is no need for extravagance now. A quiet day or two among friends will mark the occasion well enough. In any case, there will be another celebration by the end of the year.” “Quite right!” Qiu readily accepted the better counsel. “Brother Heling, taking a concubine at year’s end will be as joyful as marriage, which people liken to success in the examinations. Surely you cannot then slight that lady of ours, so talented, beautiful, virtuous and kind?” “We shall see. If official business runs smoothly and I am free at the year’s end, a celebration would do no harm.” “Good! That is all I needed to hear. Naturally I shall be the master of arrangements then.”

zh: “当然，少不得要奉烦。”嵇鹤龄又问：“老裘，你现在忙不忙？”“你晓得的，我是无事忙。”“那就忙点正经的。”嵇鹤龄向胡雪岩问道：“你看，请老裘来帮忙如何？”“那还有什么话说？”胡雪岩忽然想到一件享，便接下来问一句：“你请老裘在哪方面帮忙？”“自然是押运。”“我也猜到是这方面。”胡雪岩问裘丰言说：“老裘！请你当海运局的押运委员，你肯不肯屈就？”“谈不到这两个字。海船我还没有坐过，不晓得会不会晕船？这都不去说它了，反正你们两位说怎么，就是怎么！”“承情之至！”嵇鹤龄拱拱手，又向胡雪岩说道：“我猜你另外还有事托老裘？”
en: “Of course. We shall have to trouble you. Are you busy at present, Old Qiu?” “You know me—busy with nothing.” “Then be busy with something useful.” Ji turned to Hu. “What do you think of asking Old Qiu to help?” “What objection could there be?” Then a thought struck Hu. “What sort of help do you have in mind?” “Escorting the shipments, naturally.” “That is what I thought.” Hu turned to Qiu. “Would you condescend to serve as a convoy commissioner for the Sea Transport Bureau?” “There is no question of condescending. I have never been on a sea-going vessel and don’t know whether I might be seasick. But never mind all that. Whatever you two decide, I’ll do.” “Much obliged!” Ji clasped his hands, then said to Hu, “I suspect you have another task for Old Qiu too.”

zh: “是啊！‘烧香看和尚，一事两勾当’，等你那个条陈准了，先请老裘到松江跑一趟。”“我懂了！”嵇鹤龄说，“你想把那批枪托老裘带了回来？”“对了！”胡雪岩说，“我本来想叫我那个‘学生子’去办，一则伯他年纪轻，不够老练，再则，‘一品者百姓’的身分，到底比不上我们裘大老爷！”“好了，好了！”裘丰言用告烧的语气说，“雪岩兄，你不必调侃我了。说了半天是怎么回事？我还不甚明白。“于是胡雪岩把海运转驳和向英商购枪两事，说了个大概，裘丰言好热闹，爱朋友，对尤五这样的人，跟嵇鹤龄一样，渴望结交，运洋枪的差使，也觉得新鲜有趣，所以满口答应。“不过，说句实话，此行也不是全无意外！”嵇鹤龄提出警告，“这年头，萑苻遍地，洋枪这样的利器，暗中颇有人眼红。老裘，你是有名的‘酒糊涂’，一路上要少喝。”“少喝一点可以。你放心好了，我每顿总喝到快要糊涂为止。”
en: “Yes. Burn incense and visit the monk—two errands accomplished in one journey. Once your memorandum is approved, we can ask him to go to Songjiang first.” “I see! You want him to bring back the guns.” “Exactly. I had intended to send my young pupil. But he may be too young and inexperienced, and after all, a ‘first-rank commoner’ still cannot compare in standing with our distinguished Master Qiu.” “Enough, enough!” Qiu said in mock surrender. “Brother Xueyan, stop teasing me. You have talked for so long, and I still don’t quite understand the business.” Hu outlined the arrangements for transferring the tribute grain and buying guns from the British. Qiu loved activity and friendship. Like Ji, he was eager to meet a man such as You Laowu, and transporting foreign guns sounded new and interesting. He agreed without reservation. “But to speak frankly, the journey is not entirely without risk,” Ji warned. “Bandits are everywhere these days, and many secretly covet such effective weapons. You are famous as the Wine Muddlehead, Old Qiu. You must drink less on the way.” “I can drink a little less. Don’t worry. At every meal I always stop just short of becoming muddled.”

zh: 嵇、胡二人都笑了。“老裘！”胡雪岩好奇地问道，“你平生醉过没有？”“只醉过一趟。”裘丰言说，“是我娶亲那天，特意喝醉的。”“为什么？”胡雪岩诧异地问。“负气！”裘丰言说，“我那头亲人，是先父定下的，照我的心意，想娶东邻之女，先父说什么不许。我心里存个拙见，花轿要抬进门，我设法阻挡，洞房之中，同床异梦，是我自己的事。所以吃喜酒的时候，同学少年起哄来灌，我来者不拒，已吃到了六、七分。一进新房，我不揭新娘子的盖头，去揭酒坛子的盖头，吃得颓然大醉，人事不知，整整睡了一天一夜才醒。”“该打屁股！”胡雪岩好奇地笑着，“新娘子必是哭了一夜？”“新娘子倒没有哭，先母从没有看我醉过，吓得哭了！ 你道我醉得如何？十一月的天气，一块豆腐放在胸口，要不了多久就滚烫了。“
en: Ji and Hu laughed. “Old Qiu,” Hu asked curiously, “have you ever been drunk in your life?” “Only once. On my wedding day, and then deliberately.” “Why?” Hu asked in surprise. “Out of resentment. My late father arranged the marriage. I wanted to marry the girl next door, but he absolutely refused. I had a stubborn notion of my own: I could not stop the bridal chair from entering, but whether husband and wife shared a heart as well as a room was my affair. At the wedding feast, my young schoolfriends made a great commotion and pressed drinks on me. I refused none of them and was already six or seven parts drunk. When I entered the bridal chamber, instead of lifting the bride’s veil, I lifted the cover of a wine jar. I drank until I collapsed unconscious and slept a whole day and night before waking.” “You deserved a beating!” Hu said, laughing with curiosity. “The bride must have cried all night.” “She didn’t cry. My late mother did! She had never seen me drunk and was frightened. Do you know how drunk I was? It was the eleventh month, yet a piece of bean curd placed on my chest became burning hot in no time.”

zh: “好家伙！”胡雪岩咋舌，“你这么喝，不把命都喝掉了？”嵇鹤龄没有听他谈过这一段，此时感兴趣的是他的新娘子，便抢着问道：“尊夫人如何？虽不哭，必是苦苦相劝？”“没有那话！”裘丰言摇摇头，“你们道内人如何？只怕猜到天亮也猜不着。”“那就不要猜了，你自己从实供来！”“内人当时叫‘伴房’的回娘家，说新姑爷好酒若命，叫她娘家送二十坛好酒来……”“妙！”嵇鹤龄失声而呼，“那你怎么样呢？”“我还有怎么样？人生难得一知己，我好酒，她寻好酒来我吃，你想想，我怎么能不服帖？”嵇鹤龄跟胡雪岩都大笑，裘丰言回忆着少年的妙事，自己也笑了。“说也奇怪！”他又说，“从那一天起，我对内人的看法就两样了，原来看她胖得有些蠢，这时候想想，杨贵妃是胖的，明朝的万贵妃也是胖的，《红楼梦》上的薛宝钗也是胖的。脚是大了点，她的三寸金莲……”“慢来，慢来！”嵇鹤龄抢着问道：“三寸金莲怎么说是大脚？”“我的话还没有完。”裘丰言不慌不忙地答道，“内人的三寸金莲是横量，跟观音大士一样。”这一下，里里外外都是笑声。孩子们未见得听懂裘丰言的妙语，但极易受大人的感染，第一个丹荷就不曾看见他父亲与客人们这么笑不可抑过，因而颇有滑嵇之感，便忍不住笑得比什么人都厉害。而瑞云则已内心充满了笑意，一触即发，况且裘丰言谈他那位大脚的胖太太，措词甚“绝”，她也是听得懂的。
en: “Good heavens!” Hu clicked his tongue. “You might have drunk yourself to death.” Ji had never heard this story. He was more interested in the bride and quickly asked, “What did your wife do? Even if she didn’t cry, she must have pleaded with you.” “Nothing of the kind!” Qiu shook his head. “You could guess until daybreak and never imagine what she did.” “Then spare us the guessing and confess the truth.” “She sent the woman attending her back to her parents’ house with a message: the new son-in-law loved wine as dearly as life itself, so they should send twenty jars of good wine.” “Wonderful!” Ji exclaimed. “And what did you do?” “What could I do? It is rare in life to find someone who understands you. I loved wine, and she found good wine for me. How could I fail to surrender?” Ji and Hu laughed heartily, and Qiu laughed too at the happy absurdity of his younger days. “Strange to say, from that day I saw my wife differently. Before, I had thought her so plump that she looked stupid. Now I reflected that Imperial Consort Yang was plump, Consort Wan of the Ming was plump, and Xue Baochai in Dream of the Red Chamber was plump too. Her feet were a little large, admittedly. Those three-inch golden lotuses of hers—” “Wait!” Ji interrupted. “How can three-inch golden lotuses be large feet?” “I hadn’t finished,” Qiu replied calmly. “My wife’s three-inch lotuses are measured across, like the feet of Guanyin herself.” Laughter erupted both inside and outside. The children might not understand his wit, but the adults’ merriment was contagious. Danhe had never seen her father and his guests laugh so uncontrollably; the spectacle itself struck her as comical, and she laughed harder than anyone. Ruiyun was already so full of happiness that laughter came readily. Besides, she understood Qiu’s wonderfully pointed description of his plump, large-footed wife.

zh: 就在这一片笑声中，又有位贵客翩然而临，是王有龄，这下场面自然变得严肃了，有裘丰言在座，宾主都不便说什么涵意较深的话，一个道了贺，一个致了谢，王有龄便说：“鹤龄兄，我的移交现成，你随时可接，我看拣日不如撞日，你明天谢了委，就请移驾到局先视了事，也好让我早卸仔肩，稍松口气。”“雪公！”嵇鹤龄拱拱手用歉意的声音说，“这一层实在不能从命，容我先好好跟你老请教了再接事，如何？”“那么，”王有龄看了看裘丰言说，“丰言兄，一起到舍下便饭吧！”裘丰言也是熟透了人情世故的，听这话便知他们预先有约，当然有好些体己话要说，自己决不能去惹厌。然而他也不肯实说这层意思，“改天到府上叨拢，”他指指地下说，“鹤龄兄见委，要我为他接待贺客。我今天晚上一顿酒，就拢嵇府上的了。”这样安排也很好。于是嵇鹤龄特地入内，关照瑞云，款待嘉宾，然后道声“拜托，偏劳”，与王有龄、胡雪岩一起出门。
en: Amid the laughter another distinguished visitor arrived: Wang Youling. The atmosphere naturally became more formal. With Qiu present, neither host nor guests could speak with much hidden meaning. Once congratulations and thanks had been exchanged, Wang said, “Brother Heling, everything is ready for my handover. You may take over at any time. Rather than choose a special day, why not use the opportunity at hand? After thanking the governor tomorrow, come to the bureau and begin your duties. Then I can lay down the burden and breathe a little more easily.” “Mr Xuexuan,” Ji replied apologetically, clasping his hands, “I am afraid I cannot comply in that respect. Please let me first consult you properly before taking over.” “Then…” Wang glanced at Qiu. “Brother Fengyan, will you join us for a simple dinner at my house?” Qiu was thoroughly versed in social affairs. He understood that the others had already arranged to meet and would have private matters to discuss. He must not make himself unwelcome, but he would not state the reason openly. “I’ll impose on you another day,” he said, pointing to the floor. “Brother Heling has charged me with receiving his well-wishers. Tonight I shall impose on his household for my wine.” That suited everyone. Ji went inside especially to tell Ruiyun to look after their guest. With apologies and thanks to Qiu for his trouble, he left with Wang and Hu.

zh: 到了王家，王太太已特地从“小有天”闽菜馆叫了一桌席，为嵇鹤龄贺喜，兼为胡雪岩接风。三个人吃酒席，虽是盛馔，亦难下咽，因此胡雪岩出个主意，索性请些海运局的同事来赴席，一则作为王有龄酬谢他们平日帮忙，再则也为嵇鹤龄引见。临时飞笺召客，原是不甚礼貌的举动，不过都是局内同事，也就无所谓了。在等候甜这段时间，王有龄延客入书房，商谈移交。王有龄在海运局有亏空，但历来相沿的习惯，大致前任亏空总归后任接收，作为一笔宕帐，能弥补就弥补，不能弥补就再移交给后任。到了移交不过去时，那就要出大乱子了。当然前任是红是黑，后任是忠厚还是精明，以及彼此的交情，都有关系，在目前这种情况下，前后任等于一个人，自然没有话说。但胡雪岩觉得这件事应该有个明确的处置，否则就变成让嵇鹤龄受累，不仅于心不安，而且出了乱子，也就无异为自己找麻烦。“雪公！”他一开始就这样说，“现在等于做生意盘一爿店一样，亲兄弟明算帐，帐尽管宕在那里，算不能不算清楚。该如何归清，我们再想办法，等我上海的丝卖掉，我想就不要紧了。”听胡雪岩一说，王有龄心里有数，赶紧答道：“应该应该。我们休戚相关，灾福相共，决不能把个烂摊子甩了给鹤龄兄就算数。”这一说，事情就好办了，那笔宕帐，能报销的报销，不能报销的，宕在那里，宕不过去再说，反正有胡雪岩在，不会叫嵇鹤龄为难。至于张胖子那里，继续维持旧有的关系，也就没有什么可说的。嵇鹤龄一路听，一路点头，保持沉默，这是最适当的态度，这个差使由王有龄和胡雪岩身上而来，此刻便不宜有所主张，等接了事，只要不伤害到他们两人，自己尽可发挥，亦无须在此时有所主张。
en: At Wang’s house, Mrs Wang had ordered a banquet from the Xiaoyoutian Fujian restaurant, both to congratulate Ji and to welcome Hu home. However sumptuous the dishes, a banquet for only three would lack the company to make it enjoyable. Hu therefore proposed inviting some colleagues from the Sea Transport Bureau. It would let Wang thank them for their usual assistance and introduce them to Ji. Summoning guests with hurried invitations was not particularly courteous, but among colleagues it mattered little. While they waited, Wang took his visitors into the study to discuss the handover. There was a deficit in the bureau’s accounts. By long-standing custom, a successor generally inherited his predecessor’s deficit as an outstanding item. If he could cover it, he did; if not, he passed it on to his own successor. When it could no longer be passed on, serious trouble followed. Much depended on the predecessor’s influence, on whether the successor was accommodating or exacting, and on their relationship. Here the outgoing and incoming men were virtually one person, so no disagreement was expected. Hu nevertheless felt that a definite arrangement was necessary. Otherwise Ji would bear the burden, which would trouble Hu’s conscience; and any eventual scandal would only make trouble for Hu himself. “Mr Xuexuan,” he began, “this is like taking over a shop. Even brothers should keep clear accounts. The debt may remain outstanding, but its amount must be settled precisely. We can then decide how to clear it. Once my Shanghai silk is sold, I think there will be no difficulty.” Wang understood at once. “Of course. We share good fortune and bad. We cannot simply dump a ruined concern on Brother Heling.” That made matters easier. Whatever could be accounted for as expenditure would be so accounted for; whatever could not would remain outstanding, to be reconsidered if it could no longer be carried forward. With Hu there, Ji would not be left in difficulty. Their existing relationship with Fat Zhang would continue unchanged. Ji listened, nodding without speaking. That was the appropriate attitude. He owed the appointment to Wang and Hu; this was no time to advance his own demands. Once in office, he could exercise his abilities so long as he did not harm either of them. There was no need to assert himself now.

zh: 接着就谈到用人，这下嵇鹤龄却有话了，“雪公！”他问，“局里哪几位是非留不下可的？”王有龄懂得他的意思，“我没有什么人。”这是表示没有什么利害关系深切的私人，“不过，有一两位平日颇为出力，你能维持就维持，真的以为不行，当然也由你自己处置。”接着，王有龄说了两个可事的名字，嵇鹤龄都把他记了下来，表示一定设法维持。“那么，雪公另外有没有人要安插呢？”王有龄想了想说：“我有个远房侄于，最近从家乡来，我不想把他带到湖州，怕有人说闲话，‘官亲’太多。你如果能设法安插，那就求之不得了。”“好！请雪公叫令侄开个履历给我。”嵇鹤龄又说：“我跟雪岩商量好了，预备用裘丰言。雪公看如何？”这是嵇鹤龄的子腕，有意表示恭敬亲切，当然，王有龄即使不赞成，因为有胡雪岩的意思在内，也不会反对，而况事不干已，且对裘丰言的印象不坏，所以他连连点头：“很好，很好！”
en: When they turned to staffing, however, Ji did have something to say. “Mr Xuexuan, which men at the bureau must be retained?” Wang understood. “I have no personal men there,” he replied, meaning none whose interests were closely bound to his own. “But one or two have worked hard. Keep them if you can. If you really find them unsuitable, of course it is for you to decide.” He named two colleagues. Ji noted their names and said he would do his best to retain them. “Is there anyone else you would like a place found for?” Wang considered. “A distant nephew has recently come from our native place. I do not want to take him to Huzhou, for fear people will say there are too many official relatives about. If you could place him, I should be most grateful.” “Certainly. Please have him give me an account of his qualifications. Xueyan and I have also agreed that we should like to employ Qiu Fengyan. What do you think?” This was Ji’s tact: he deliberately showed respect and cordiality. Even had Wang disapproved, he would scarcely have objected to an arrangement Hu supported. In fact, it did not concern his interests, and he thought well of Qiu. He nodded repeatedly. “Very good, very good.”

zh: “再有，”胡雪岩接着说，“到松江去接洋枪，我想请老裘顺便去跑一趟，请雪公再弄件公事。”“公文方便。不过‘酒糊涂’办这种事，会不会出纰漏？”王有龄说，“我看最好叫你那个姓陈的后生跟了他去，这个人年纪虽轻，人倒能干。”“既然寻公看他能干，不妨在猢州给他一个什么差使。”胡雪岩毫不思索他说了这一句，想想又不对，赶紧再接一句：“当然是挂名差使。”“挂名差使又何必？”“有个道理。”胡雪岩说，“陈世龙年底要成亲了。有个差使，便算衣冠中人，男女两家的场面上都好看些。”“这可以！”王有龄随口答道，“女家是哪一家？”“新娘子就是阿珠。”“咦！”王有龄和嵇鹤龄不约而同的面现诧异之色，而且都非常困惑，不知这话怎么问下去？也不需他们动问，胡雪岩自己把那段移植蓬门清卉的经过，讲了一遍。王有龄和嵇鹤龄自然都极注意的在听，但两人的反应不同，王有龄是替他惋惜，嵇鹤龄则颇为赞成，说胡雪岩这件“快举”，大有唐人侠义之风。
en: “There is another matter,” Hu added. “I should like Old Qiu to go to Songjiang and collect the foreign guns on the same journey. Please arrange another official document.” “The papers are easy. But will the Wine Muddlehead make a mistake on such an errand? I think it would be best to send that young fellow Chen with him. He is young, but capable.” “Since you think him capable, why not give him some appointment in Huzhou?” Hu said without thinking. Then, realizing that this was not quite what he wanted, he quickly added, “A nominal appointment, of course.” “Why a nominal one?” “There is a reason. Chen Shilong is to marry at the end of the year. An appointment would put him among men entitled to official dress and make a better showing for both families.” “That can be done,” Wang replied casually. “Whose family is the bride from?” “The bride is A’zhu.” “Ah!” Wang and Ji showed the same surprise and bewilderment, neither knowing how to pursue the question. They did not need to ask. Hu himself related how he had arranged the future of that fresh blossom from a humble home. Both listened closely, but their reactions differed. Wang felt regret on Hu’s behalf; Ji approved heartily, saying that this spirited act had the chivalrous generosity of a hero from a Tang tale.
